all.name: Scarlet Witch
all.description: Wanda Maximoff is adept at harnessing formidable chaos magic, casting hexes with the power to twist and reshape reality itself. Energy, space, and matter are mere playthings in the hands of Scarlet Witch!

item.name: Chaos Control
item.description: Unleash Chaos Magic on enemies to deal damage and restore <Orange>Chaos Energy</>

additional_fields.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 3m and a height of 20m
additional_fields.Special_Effect_1: Attack the nearest enemy within range
additional_fields.Special_Effect_2: Hitting with Chaos Control charges Chthonian Burst

item.name: Chthonian Burst
item.description: Consume <Orange>Chaos Energy</> to fire explosive magic missiles, damaging enemies.

additional_fields.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

item.name: Dark Seal
item.description: Land a hit on a target or the scene, or press again to generate a Force Field that periodically <Debuff>Stuns</> enemies within range.

additional_fields.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

item.name: Mystic Projection
item.description: Enter the <Orange>Phased</> state for free-flight. Press {Ability2} to exit early.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: During this period, Scarlet Witch enters the Projection state, can be healed by teammates

item.name: Reality Erasure
item.description: Engage in free-flight while gaining <Buff>Bonus Health</> and charging energy. While flying, continuously <Debuff>pull in</> nearby enemies, then unleash charged energy to deal massive area damage.

additional_fields.Slow_Rate: Begin to slow down by 1.5s, with the effect gradually increasing to -25% by 3.5s
additional_fields.Special_Effect: During this period, Scarlet Witch enters a Free-flight state, pulls in nearby enemies (within 15m radius) during cast charge. Max pull speed up to 3m/s

item.name: Arcane Order
item.description: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery with Scarlet Witch and Magik. Scarlet Witch's <Orange>Chthonian Burst</> is replaced with <Orange>Mystic Burst</> upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction. Magik can unleash a <Orange>Chain of Cyttorak</> that links two enemies and slows them; the farther they are apart, the greater the <Debuff>Slow</> effect inflicted during the link.
